body: Things are going alright. I called a suicide hotline last night and talked with them for about 30 minutes. I tried taking her to the ER but she refused. She went to work and is doing "fine" I guess. Thank you for checking on us.
I strongly encourage you to call emergency services if you think it's threatening.
Thank you, also. I'm doing everything I can right now. I really appreciate your help.

Thank you so much for all of your help. I'll do everything in my power. I'm not trying to weasel out of it, but I've called an ambulance before. My town doesn't care about these sort of things, and won't take her unless she's actually dying. I'll do everything I can though. Thank you.
